description: Test whether ClinVar pathogenic ATP1A2 missense variants cluster in transmembrane helices relative to gnomAD population missense background
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, time, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, binomtest

def gql(q, tries=6):
    for a in range(tries):
        try:
            r=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},timeout=180)
            if r.status_code==200 and r.text.strip().startswith("{"): return r.json()
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(6)
    raise RuntimeError("fail")

CV = pd.DataFrame(gql('{gene(gene_symbol:"ATP1A2",reference_genome:GRCh38){clinvar_variants{variant_id clinical_significance major_consequence hgvsp}}}')["data"]["gene"]["clinvar_variants"])
GV = pd.DataFrame(gql('{gene(gene_symbol:"ATP1A2",reference_genome:GRCh38){variants(dataset:gnomad_r4){variant_id consequence hgvsp exome{ac an filters} genome{ac an filters}}}}')["data"]["gene"]["variants"])

u = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P50993.json", timeout=60).json()
L = u["sequence"]["length"]
tm = [(f["location"]["start"]["value"], f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in u["features"] if f["type"]=="Transmembrane"]
tm_mask = np.zeros(L+1, bool)
for s,e in tm: tm_mask[s:e+1]=True
tm_frac = tm_mask[1:].sum()/L

aa3={'Ala','Arg','Asn','Asp','Cys','Gln','Glu','Gly','His','Ile','Leu','Lys','Met','Phe','Pro','Ser','Thr','Trp','Tyr','Val'}
def res_of(h):
    if not isinstance(h,str): return np.nan
    m=re.search(r'p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)',h)
    return int(m.group(2)) if m and m.group(1) in aa3 else np.nan

CV["res"]=CV["hgvsp"].apply(res_of)
CV["path"]=CV["clinical_significance"].isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])
pm = CV[(CV["major_consequence"]=="missense_variant")&CV["path"]].dropna(subset=["res"])

GV["res"]=GV["hgvsp"].apply(res_of)
gmis = GV[(GV["consequence"]=="missense_variant")].dropna(subset=["res"])
# population background: missense seen in gnomAD and NOT classified pathogenic in ClinVar
pset = set(pm["variant_id"])
gbg = gmis[~gmis["variant_id"].isin(pset)]

a=int(tm_mask[pm["res"].astype(int)].sum()); b=len(pm)-a
c=int(tm_mask[gbg["res"].astype(int)].sum()); d=len(gbg)-c
orr,p = fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
bt = binomtest(a, len(pm), tm_frac, alternative="greater")
print(f"Transmembrane helices (n={len(tm)}) cover {tm_frac*100:.1f}% of the 1020-aa protein")
print(f"ClinVar P/LP missense in TM: {a}/{len(pm)} = {a/len(pm)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"gnomAD population missense in TM: {c}/{len(gbg)} = {c/len(gbg)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Fisher exact OR = {orr:.2f}, p = {p:.3g}")
print(f"Binomial vs {tm_frac*100:.1f}% null: p = {bt.pvalue:.3g}, 95% CI {bt.proportion_ci().low:.3f}-{bt.proportion_ci().high:.3f}")

# per-domain functional annotation
regions = {"N-terminal cytoplasmic (1-85)":(1,85),
           "Actuator (A) domain ~90-280":(90,280),
           "Phosphorylation (P) domain ~350-440 + 580-620":(350,440),
           "Nucleotide (N) domain ~440-580":(440,580),
           "C-terminal TM M5-M10 (~760-1020)":(760,1020)}
print("\nP/LP missense density by region (variants per 100 aa):")
for name,(s,e) in regions.items():
    n = ((pm["res"]>=s)&(pm["res"]<=e)).sum()
    g = ((gbg["res"]>=s)&(gbg["res"]<=e)).sum()
    print(f"  {name:45s} P/LP {n:3d} ({n/(e-s+1)*100:5.2f}/100aa)   gnomAD {g:3d} ({g/(e-s+1)*100:5.2f}/100aa)  ratio {(n/max(g,1)):.2f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.4),sharex=True,gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1,1]})
for ax in axes:
    for s,e in tm: ax.axvspan(s,e,color="#DCDCDC",zorder=0)
    ax.axvline(374,color="#2E7D32",ls=":",lw=1.5)
axes[0].hist(pm["res"],bins=np.arange(0,L+21,20),color="#C44E52")
axes[0].set_ylabel("count / 20 aa")
axes[0].set_title("ClinVar pathogenic and likely pathogenic ATP1A2 missense variants (n=%d)\ngrey = transmembrane helices, green dotted = Asp374 phosphorylation site"%len(pm))
axes[1].hist(gbg["res"],bins=np.arange(0,L+21,20),color="#4C72B0")
axes[1].set_ylabel("count / 20 aa"); axes[1].set_xlabel("ATP1A2 residue (UniProt P50993)")
axes[1].set_title("gnomAD v4 population missense variants, same gene (n=%d)"%len(gbg))
axes[1].set_xlim(0,L)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
